title: Classify the Contract
prompt:
Implement `const char* classify(int code)` mapping each code to its standard-contract class for the construct described:
 
- code 0: reading `sizeof(int)` → returns `"implementation-defined"`
- code 1: the value of an uninitialized automatic `int` → returns `"indeterminate"`
- code 2: signed integer overflow → returns `"undefined"`
- code 3: order of evaluation of two function arguments → returns `"unspecified"`
- code 4: `unsigned int` wraparound on overflow → returns `"well-defined"`
 
Any other code returns `"unknown"`.

tests.name: all six codes
tests.hint: A plain switch on code; unsigned arithmetic is fully defined modulo 2^N.

tests.name: default is unknown
tests.hint: The default case must return the same string for any unrecognized code.
